result.brief: 提出单阶段扩散框架，将透视视频生成与全景演化耦合，用几何锚定与时间补偿实现视角离开后动态物体的持续演化，提升世界模型的动态持久性与回访一致性。
result.reason: Action-conditioned video diffusion world model with panoramic latent evolution for persistent dynamic objects; contributes a coupled generation framework and geometric/temporal bridging, directly a video world model.
